triggers.description: Bare Actuating implements, publishes, reviews, and closes.
Explicit route selects implement, analyze, or review-closeout.
Current or projected witnessed failures require causal construction analysis.
exclusions: mechanical mistake with no correctness-bearing semantic pressure

triggers.description: A current witness may revoke an exact excluded-family claim.
Review scheduling falsifies a completed candidate.

routes.description: Compile the deepest honest read-only construction judgment from current evidence.
Falsify, compile successor, realize, publish, and converge.

required_artifacts: owner-issued proof, review, counterexample, and publication evidence as applicable
success_signals: Git owns realization; verifiers own executed proof; CAS owns review; Review Fold owns CEX admission; Ship owns public effects
current causal interpretation and closure are ephemeral
failure_signals: agent-authored labels or equal digests certify semantics
Actuating duplicates an owner store or adds a transition gate
clauses.rationale: Evidence ownership is not transferred by a packet or workflow label.

success_signals: initial implementation may mutate without review dispatch
existing evidence may inform implementation without opening review
local completion needs no CAS convergence or publication
failure_signals: a review wave or counterexample is required before initial implementation
initial architecture is blocked pending a revoked predecessor theorem
clauses.rationale: Implementation constructs the candidate; review later falsifies it.

required_artifacts: applicable terminal outcomes, recovery, and Review Fold
success_signals: candidate stays frozen through the applicable cut
serial and parallel acquire the same initial six-lens evidence
confirmation invalidation requires no new auxiliary wave on the invalid head
failure_signals: mutation inside an open epoch
initial implementation forced to review first
verdictless recovery omitted from the barrier
clauses.rationale: The freeze belongs to review, not Actuating globally.

success_signals: only current entailed accepted witnesses create automatic correctness pressure
every semantic delta has counterexample, Goal, or explicit new authority
claim corrections and residuals retain authority and closure consequences
failure_signals: rejected strengthening implemented to protect review convergence
duplicate observation treated as a new causal dimension
claim narrowing silently weakens accepted behavior
clauses.rationale: Adjudication governs actual code, not just the response narrative.

required_artifacts: cumulative current and applicable historical basis
source-supported enabling cause and invalid-family domain
actual exact-head proof and compensator dispositions
success_signals: selection targets family exclusion rather than preservation of the incumbent
a local correction may restore an adequate family mechanism without forced redesign
a mechanism change may win without disproving every possible local repair
plausible subtractive alternatives are tested when redundancy is evidenced
failure_signals: one special case per finding
mandatory local-repair-first or refactor-everything default
restoration label bypasses family or path proof
hypothesized family or sampled siblings called universal proof
clauses.rationale: Learn a cause, predict beyond observed examples, and prove the realized construction.

required_artifacts: resource account, smallest witness, and falsifier
success_signals: one bounded Glaze-primed Metanoetic challenge under the existing trigger, before Universalist
canonical Glaze then Metanoetic instructions share one context; encouragement does not change admissibility or proof
incumbent-generated burdens may be eliminated while required observations survive
adopted mechanism change updates actual proof obligations
failure_signals: pre-mutation theorem certificate required to think about a better mechanism
hard constraints ignored or new authority silently adopted
unchanged surface receives duplicate challenges
Glaze adds a trigger, pass, report, review, or acceptance authority
clauses.rationale: Constrain candidate admissibility, not imagination; preserve bounded supporting ownership.

required_artifacts: live independently governed axis and typed hole
complete candidate, preserve-incumbent, or obstructed nomination
cut K, topology transformation tau, total disposition law F
verifier selected before implementation and executed on actual T1
preservation, cut coverage, residuals, and claim ceiling
success_signals: source authority determines the domain instead of a model-authored list
independent seams are split and recomposed with proof
new undispositioned source elements invalidate closure
adequate existing derivations are reused for unchanged boundaries
failure_signals: prose nomination substitutes for complete realization
a local label waives a changed boundary contract
retired predecessor paths are required to exist in T1
bounded evidence silently becomes elimination
clauses.rationale: Universalist nominates the boundary; Actuating proves actual source-derived realization.

required_artifacts: live owner-source frontier and unavailable-source limitations
exact CAS receipts and native/default standard review
success_signals: all current and applicable historical sources inform one causal basis
unavailable provider quota is not a clean verdict
six-lens inventory and five-standard-clean convergence are preserved
failure_signals: custom instructions replace the default standard review
live provider finding omitted while dependent action proceeds
absence in incomplete history proves first occurrence or elimination
clauses.rationale: Review supplies falsification evidence; it neither chooses repairs nor silently adds requirements.

required_artifacts: actual exact-head construction proof under a common bar
Ship/provider and CAS convergence when required
success_signals: family excluded at the declared strength and required-valid behavior survives
all relevant paths and residuals accounted for
redundant primary compensation retired or justified by distinct obligations
same-claim witness revokes exclusion and reopens its causal explanation
failure_signals: only reported examples repaired
labels or digests substitute for construction evidence
unresolved or unauthorized residual liability called complete
clean reviews or policy fixtures claimed as universal proof or controlled model efficacy
clauses.rationale: Success is justified behavior in the actual code, not process completion or route classification.

instrumentation.rationale: Current judgments are ephemeral; existing owner evidence and offline audits evaluate results.
